# Vectors: il-dnp-encoding

Guideline baseline: `2f00e9f` · Kind: dnp-encoding · 15 vectors · [All vector files](README.md)

dnp-encoding vectors (MG A3): examples of Table 5 and of the URI example, the character classes of Table 4 and the extension to all UTF-8 octets (SF-043 a). They define the encoding when it is used; its use is optional and limited to the Oi4Identifier elements (REQ-IL-033, SF-043 e).
